questions.question: Where should 'never send anything on Slack in my name' live?
options: In CLAUDE.md, under Stop and ask
In a Slack message to Claude
questions.explanation: Standing rules go in CLAUDE.md so they load at every session start.

questions.question: You have ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ~/Finanz/growth-os/CLAUDE.md. Working in growth-os, Claude reads...
questions.explanation: All levels load, most specific last. Global says who you are, project says what this folder is.

questions.question: Which line belongs in a CLAUDE.md?
options: Numbers come from Adjust, cohort d7, never the Meta dashboard
questions.explanation: Only lines that change behaviour. Never secrets. Politeness is noise.

questions.question: What does a line `@glossary.md` do?
options: Inlines that file into CLAUDE.md at load
questions.explanation: @ imports pull other files in, so the main CLAUDE.md stays short and readable.
